en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large open square with gardens, walking paths, and people strolling. On the left is a long row of multi‑story buildings with arcades and a towered structure in the middle distance. Behind the town rise steep, rocky mountains. The caption at the bottom margin reads "TRENTO - Piazza Venezia," identifying the scene as a city square in Trento, Italy.
